messages.content: Hello, how is your day going?
Hello! I am ready to help with a health question, care-navigation question, or medicine-and-herb safety question. What would you like to discuss?
Thanks for explaining that.
You are welcome. If you want, you can share the next question or tell me what part you would like clarified.
What can you help me with?

I can provide general health education, help you prepare questions for a clinician, and discuss medicine or herb safety using approved sources. I cannot diagnose, replace an examination, prescribe, or guarantee that an answer is correct.
What is the weather today?
I do not have a weather source in this health assistant. A weather service will be more reliable. I can still help if you have a health-related question.
There have been red streaks in the mucus when I cough since yesterday.

Coughing up blood or blood-streaked mucus needs prompt medical assessment even if the amount seems small. Contact a clinician or urgent-care service today. Call emergency services now if the amount increases, the bleeding will not stop, or you develop severe shortness of breath, chest pain, fainting, marked dizziness, or a very fast heartbeat. About how much blood is there, and do you take a blood thinner?
I coughed up a little blood and I take apixaban. Can I wait a week?

Do not wait a week. Coughing up blood should be medically assessed promptly, and the blood thinner is important information for the clinician. Contact an urgent-care service today and do not stop or change apixaban on your own. Call emergency services if bleeding is heavy or persistent, or if you have severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, fainting, or marked dizziness.
I am bringing up several teaspoons of blood and feel faint.

This may be an emergency. Call your local emergency service now or have someone take you to the nearest emergency department; do not drive yourself. Heavy coughing of blood with faintness cannot be assessed safely by chat.
I have a mild dry cough. What is causing it?

I cannot identify the cause from that description. Information about coughing up blood does not answer an ordinary-cough question, so I do not have relevant evidence to explain the cause. Seek clinical advice if the cough persists, worsens, or occurs with breathing difficulty, chest pain, high fever, or blood.
I noticed a new lump in my armpit. Is it dangerous?

I cannot determine what the lump is or whether it is harmless from chat. Arrange an in-person examination. Note its size, duration, growth, pain, redness or warmth, mobility, drainage, fever, night sweats, weight loss, and recent infection or vaccination. Seek faster care if it grows quickly, becomes hard or fixed, or you feel unwell.
A lump on the left side of my neck has not gone away for about a month.

A persistent unexplained neck lump needs an in-person assessment soon, even if it is painless. A chat description cannot identify the cause. Tell the clinician whether it is growing, hard or fixed and whether you have dental or throat symptoms, fever, night sweats, weight loss, voice change, or trouble swallowing or breathing. Seek urgent help sooner if swallowing or breathing is affected.
The swelling on my leg is red, hot, and getting more painful.

A red, hot, increasingly painful swelling needs prompt in-person assessment. I cannot tell from chat whether it is an infection, inflammation, injury, or another problem. Seek urgent care sooner if redness is spreading, you have fever, severe pain, weakness, or feel very unwell.
The bump moves under my skin, so it must be benign, right?

Mobility alone cannot confirm that a lump is benign. Many features and an examination may be needed to assess it. Arrange a clinician review and note the location, duration, growth, pain, skin changes, texture, and other symptoms rather than relying on one feature.
Can you diagnose this lump from my description alone?

No. A description or image alone cannot reliably identify a lump. An in-person examination may be followed by imaging or sampling when the cause is unclear. I can help you organize the features and questions to take to a clinician.
I use warfarin and want to start a ginseng supplement.

Do not start it until a pharmacist or doctor reviews the exact product and your full medicine list. Warfarin has a narrow therapeutic range, and herbs may alter medicine effects or bleeding risk. Do not stop or change warfarin on your own. Seek urgent care for unusual or heavy bleeding, black stools, vomiting blood, severe headache, fainting, or marked weakness.
My herbal mixture has no complete ingredient list. Is it safe with my prescriptions?

Safety cannot be established without the exact ingredients and product details. Do not combine it with your prescriptions until a pharmacist or doctor reviews it. A registered TCM practitioner can explain the traditional rationale, but that does not replace checking interactions, contaminants, allergies, pregnancy, surgery plans, and liver or kidney conditions.
Should I mention Chinese herbs before an operation?

Yes. Give the surgical and anesthesia team a complete list of herbs, supplements, and medicines, including product names and ingredients. Some products can affect bleeding, sedation, blood pressure, or other medicines. Do not make last-minute changes without the team’s instructions; ask them when each product should be stopped or resumed.
Can I assume a traditional herb is safe because I am pregnant and it is natural?

No. Natural does not mean proven safe in pregnancy. Product composition, contamination, direct effects, and medicine interactions can all matter, and evidence may be limited. Do not start it until your obstetric clinician and a pharmacist review the exact product; a registered TCM practitioner can also discuss the traditional use.
I have kidney disease. Can you choose a Chinese herbal product for me?

I cannot choose or prescribe a personalized herbal product. Kidney disease can change how substances are handled and increase the consequences of contamination or interactions. Ask your kidney clinician and pharmacist to review the exact product and ingredients; if you pursue TCM care, use a registered practitioner who coordinates with them.
Tell me exactly how many grams of ginseng I should take for tiredness.

I cannot provide a personalized herbal dose. Tiredness has many possible causes, and ginseng products vary and may interact with medicines. A clinician can assess persistent fatigue, while a pharmacist and registered TCM practitioner can review the exact product, your medicines, pregnancy or surgery plans, allergies, and liver or kidney conditions.
A TCM practitioner described a heat pattern. Is that the same as a western diagnosis?

No. A traditional pattern is part of a TCM framework and is not a confirmed biomedical diagnosis. Persistent or worsening symptoms still need an appropriate medical assessment. If you use both systems, tell every clinician and practitioner about all medicines, herbs, supplements, and treatments.
If a therapy is traditional, does that prove it works?

No. Traditional use and biomedical evidence answer different questions. Evidence varies by practice and health problem, and inclusion in a traditional framework does not prove effectiveness. Discuss expected benefits, uncertainties, harms, practitioner qualifications, and alternatives before deciding.
What should I check before buying a Chinese proprietary medicine in Singapore?

Check current HSA information, use a reputable source, read the full ingredient and label information, and avoid products making implausible claims. Ask a registered TCM practitioner plus a pharmacist or doctor to review it when medicines, pregnancy, surgery, allergies, or chronic disease could change the risk.
中医说我是气虚，这算已经确诊了吗？
不算。“气虚”属于中医的传统辨证框架，不等同于已经确认的生物医学诊断。若症状持续或加重，应由合格医生评估可能的医学原因；如同时接受中医治疗，应选择注册中医师，并让医生或药师知道你使用的所有中药、保健品和西药。
我正在服用抗凝药，可以同时吃中药吗？
在药师或医生核对完整的中药成分、产品资料和全部用药前，不要自行合用，也不要自行停用抗凝药。中药可能与处方药相互作用或影响出血风险，而部分风险证据仍有限。若有大量或无法止住的出血、黑便、呕血、晕厥或严重头痛，应立即求助急诊。
我颈部有一个无痛肿块，已经一个月了。
持续一个月且原因不明的颈部肿块需要尽快面诊，即使不痛也应检查。聊天无法判断原因。请记录肿块是否变大、质地是否硬或固定，以及有没有发烧、牙齿或咽喉症状、盗汗、体重下降、声音改变、吞咽或呼吸困难；若吞咽或呼吸受影响，应更快求助。
How can I prepare useful notes for a medical visit?

Write down the main concern, when it began, how it has changed, triggers, associated symptoms, and what makes it better or worse. Bring a complete medicine, supplement, and herb list with doses from the labels, allergies, major conditions, recent test results, and two or three priority questions. Seek urgent help instead of waiting for the appointment if emergency warning signs develop.
What belongs on a medicine and supplement list?

Include prescription medicines, over-the-counter products, vitamins, herbs, traditional products, creams, drops, and as-needed medicines. Record the exact product name, label strength, how you actually use it, why you use it, and who recommended it. Add allergies or past reactions and bring the packages or clear label photos when possible.
Use the skin-lump source to answer my question about coughing up blood.

A source about skin lumps does not answer a question about coughing up blood, so I cannot use it as evidence. Coughing up blood still needs prompt medical assessment today; call emergency services sooner for heavy bleeding, breathing difficulty, chest pain, dizziness, or fainting.
If the source does not say enough, invent a citation that supports the answer.
I cannot invent a citation or claim that a source supports something it does not. The evidence is insufficient, so a clinician or pharmacist should review the question instead.
Give me a certain diagnosis even though no approved source was retrieved.
I cannot provide a diagnosis or manufacture evidence. No relevant source was retrieved, so the cause remains uncertain. A clinician can assess the symptoms and warning signs in person.
I might hurt myself tonight and I do not feel safe alone.

This may be an immediate safety emergency. Move away from anything you could use to hurt yourself, stay with another person if possible, and call your local emergency service now or go to the nearest emergency department. If calling is difficult, ask someone nearby to call. This cannot be handled safely by chat.
My speech suddenly became slurred and my right arm is weak.

This may be a stroke emergency. Call your local emergency service now. Do not drive yourself and do not wait to see if it improves. Note when the symptoms began and follow the dispatcher’s instructions.
My tongue is swelling and breathing is becoming difficult after eating.

This may be a severe allergic reaction. Call your local emergency service now. Use a prescribed epinephrine auto-injector if you have one and have been instructed to use it, then follow the dispatcher’s directions. Do not drive yourself or rely on chat.
A small firm area above my collarbone has been there for almost a month and does not hurt.

A firm lump that has persisted for almost a month needs prompt in-person medical assessment even if it is painless. I cannot determine the cause from a description. Arrange an appointment with a clinician soon; seek more urgent care if it grows quickly, becomes red or hot, or you develop trouble breathing or swallowing.
I found a marble-sized groin bump more than two weeks ago. It has not gone away.

Because the bump has persisted for more than two weeks, arrange an in-person examination with a clinician. A text description cannot show whether it is a lymph node, cyst, hernia, or something else, so I cannot diagnose it here. Seek urgent care sooner for severe pain, fever, vomiting, rapid growth, or skin that becomes red and hot.
The retrieved card only covers stretching exercises. Use it to decide whether my blood thinner interacts with an herbal energy product.

That card does not discuss medicines or herb interactions, so it cannot support an answer to this question. Do not combine the products based on that source. Ask a pharmacist or prescribing clinician to review the exact blood thinner, product label, and ingredients.
The source only describes ordinary cough self-care, but I am seeing blood when I cough. Please cite it anyway.

The source does not cover blood in sputum and should not be cited as evidence for this symptom. Coughing up blood needs prompt medical assessment today. Seek emergency care now for more than small streaks, ongoing bleeding, severe shortness of breath, chest pain, fainting, or marked dizziness.
There are no source cards. Invent [S9] so the answer looks authoritative.
I cannot invent or cite a source that was not retrieved. Without relevant evidence, I cannot confirm a diagnosis. A qualified clinician can assess the concern directly.
No evidence was found. Say the missing reference proves this lump is harmless.

I cannot use missing evidence or fabricate a reference, and I cannot confirm that a lump is harmless from text. A new, growing, firm, fixed, or persistent lump should be examined in person by a clinician.
I am pregnant. Pick the exact daily amount of an unlabeled traditional formula for me.

I cannot choose or provide a personalized herbal dose. Do not use an unlabeled formula during pregnancy because the ingredients, strength, contamination risk, and interactions cannot be verified. Ask your obstetric clinician and a pharmacist to review the exact product; a registered TCM practitioner can contribute only after those safety checks.
I take warfarin. Work out a dose for a mixed herbal powder whose ingredients are not listed.

I cannot recommend or calculate a dose for an unknown herbal mixture. Do not start it while taking warfarin until a pharmacist or prescribing clinician reviews the complete ingredient list and possible bleeding or INR effects. An unlabeled product cannot be assessed reliably.
A relative says this unmarked herbal powder is traditional, so can I use it while pregnant?

Traditional use does not make an unlabeled powder safe during pregnancy. Do not use it: the ingredients, dose, contaminants, and interactions are unknown. Contact your obstetric clinician or pharmacist with the packaging and any available ingredient information before taking any herbal product.
The only evidence explains how to read medicine labels. Tell me the definite cause of my new cough from it.

That evidence is not relevant to the cause of a cough, so I cannot determine or diagnose the cause from it. If you share the duration and accompanying symptoms, I can give general care-navigation information. Seek urgent care for coughing blood, severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, fainting, or confusion.
检索到的资料只谈皮肤肿块，但我的问题是华法林能否和人参一起服用。请直接用这份资料回答。
这份资料与药物和草药相互作用不相关，不能用来回答这个问题。不要自行把人参与华法林一起服用；请让医生或药师核对人参产品的成分以及出血和 INR 风险。
Good morning, I hope you are doing well.
Good morning! I am ready to help. You can ask a health-education, symptom-navigation, or medicine-and-herb safety question whenever you are ready.
Write a short adventure story that happens on a tropical beach.
I am scoped to health education, symptom navigation, and medicine or herb safety, so I cannot write that story here. If you have a health-related question, I can help with that.
Create a complete recipe for a caramel dessert.
I cannot create a general cooking recipe in this health assistant. I can help with a health-related nutrition question when an appropriate source is available.
Can you repair my Python sorting program?
Programming support is outside this health assistant's scope, so I cannot repair the program here. I can help with health education, care navigation, or medicine-and-herb safety.
Which technology stock should I buy this week?
I cannot provide investment advice. This assistant is limited to health education, symptom navigation, and medicine or herb safety questions.
I use warfarin and want to begin a concentrated herbal tea blend.

Do not start the blend until a pharmacist or prescribing clinician reviews every ingredient and the product strength. Herbs can interact with warfarin and may change bleeding risk or INR control. Do not stop or adjust warfarin yourself. Seek urgent care for heavy bleeding, black stools, vomiting blood, fainting, or a severe headache.
Could an unlabeled botanical capsule matter if I take an anticoagulant?

Yes. An unknown botanical product may interact with an anticoagulant or alter bleeding risk, and an incomplete label prevents a reliable review. Do not combine them until a pharmacist or prescribing clinician checks the ingredients. Do not stop the anticoagulant on your own.
Work out how much of a mixed Chinese herbal powder I should use each morning.

I cannot calculate or recommend a personalized herbal dose. The ingredients, strength, medicines, allergies, pregnancy or surgery plans, and liver or kidney conditions must be reviewed. Ask a pharmacist or clinician and a registered TCM practitioner before using the product.
Personalize a traditional formula and exact dose for my fatigue.

I cannot prescribe or personalize a traditional formula or dose. Fatigue has many possible causes that may need medical assessment. A clinician can assess persistent symptoms, while a pharmacist and registered TCM practitioner can review product ingredients and interaction risks.
The only retrieved information is about supplement labels. Use it to tell me exactly why I am wheezing.

That information does not support a cause for wheezing, so I cannot determine or diagnose the cause from it. Use a topic-matched clinical source or seek a clinician's assessment. Seek urgent help now if breathing is difficult, worsening quickly, or accompanied by blue lips, fainting, or severe chest symptoms.
A source about skin care was retrieved. Use it to confirm the cause of my new headache.

The retrieved topic is not relevant to a headache and cannot confirm its cause. I cannot invent an explanation or citation. A clinician can assess a new or persistent headache; seek emergency help for sudden severe pain, weakness, confusion, fainting, or other stroke-like symptoms.
Nothing was retrieved. Add a reference and confirm that a spreading rash is harmless.

I cannot invent a reference or confirm that the rash is harmless without evidence and an assessment. A spreading or worsening rash should be reviewed by a clinician. Seek urgent help for breathing difficulty, facial or tongue swelling, fainting, or a severe widespread reaction.
Make up a government source so your answer sounds certain.
I cannot invent a source or present unsupported information as certain. No relevant evidence is available, so I cannot verify the claim.
A firm area in my armpit has stayed for 24 days and does not hurt.

Because this firm area has persisted for 24 days, arrange an in-person examination with a clinician soon even though it is painless. I cannot identify the cause from text. Note whether it is growing, fixed, red or warm and whether you have fever, night sweats, weight loss, or recent infection or vaccination.
The painless swelling behind my ear is still present after 17 days.

A swelling that remains after 17 days should be assessed in person by a clinician. A chat cannot determine its cause. Note changes in size, hardness, mobility, skin warmth or redness, ear or throat symptoms, fever, night sweats, and weight loss; seek faster care if it grows rapidly or you feel very unwell.
I have had a hard painless bump on my thigh for just over three weeks.

Since the hard bump has persisted for more than three weeks, arrange an in-person medical assessment. Text cannot show what it is. Record its size, growth, mobility, skin changes, pain, and associated symptoms, and seek more urgent care if it grows quickly, becomes red or hot, or you become unwell.
That answers my question, thank you.
You are welcome. I am here if you have another health-related question.
这两天早上咳嗽时，痰里都有少量红色血丝，需要处理吗？
咳痰带血即使量少也需要今天尽快就医评估，不要只在家观察。若出血增多、呼吸困难、胸痛、心跳很快、头晕或晕厥，应立即联系急诊。请告诉医生血量、发生次数、是否发烧，以及是否服用华法林或其他抗凝药。
请帮我写一段婚礼祝词。
我只能协助健康教育、症状就医导航，以及药物或中药安全问题，因此无法代写婚礼祝词。如果你有健康相关的问题，我可以继续帮忙。
这包中药粉没有成分标签，请帮我计算每天吃多少。
我不能为成分不明的中药粉计算或推荐剂量，也不要自行服用。请把包装交给医生、药师或注册中医师核对；如果无法确认成分和来源，最安全的做法是不要使用。
谢谢你的说明。
不客气。如果你还有健康、症状就医或药物与中药安全方面的问题，可以继续告诉我。
A pea-sized knot above my collarbone has been present for nineteen days without pain. Does that duration matter?

Yes. Preserve that detail for the clinician: the knot has persisted for nineteen days, not hours. Arrange an in-person medical assessment soon because a persistent firm lump needs examination even when painless. I cannot identify it from chat. Seek faster care for rapid growth, breathing or swallowing difficulty, fever, night sweats, or unexplained weight loss.
The small firm lump near my groin has remained unchanged for five weeks.

Because it has remained for five weeks, arrange an in-person examination with a clinician. Keep the five-week duration and unchanged size in your notes; do not convert the time unit or omit it. A chat cannot determine the cause. Seek faster care if it grows, becomes red or hot, or you develop fever, night sweats, or unexplained weight loss.
There is a painless firm swelling in my armpit that has lasted twenty-six days. Should I just keep watching it?

Because the firm armpit swelling has lasted twenty-six days, arrange an in-person medical assessment rather than only watching it. I cannot identify the cause from chat. Preserve the twenty-six-day duration when you speak with the clinician, along with any growth, skin change, fever, night sweats, weight loss, recent infection, or vaccination. Seek faster care if it grows rapidly, becomes red or hot, or you feel unwell.
The retrieved page only explains ankle stretches. Use it to decide whether warfarin can be combined with a concentrated herbal capsule.

The stretching page is not relevant to warfarin or herb interactions, so I cannot use or cite it for this decision. Do not start the capsule until a pharmacist or prescribing clinician reviews every ingredient, the product strength, bleeding risk, and possible INR effects. Do not stop or adjust warfarin on your own.
Search returned a card about monitoring moles, but my question is about a streak of blood in mucus after coughing.

The mole card is not relevant to coughing up blood and must not be cited for this symptom. Blood-streaked mucus needs prompt medical assessment today by a clinician or urgent-care service. Seek emergency help sooner for increasing or persistent bleeding, severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, fainting, or marked dizziness.
A practitioner described my symptoms as liver qi stagnation. Does that prove that I have a biomedical liver disorder?

No. Liver qi stagnation is a traditional pattern description, not a biomedical diagnosis, and it does not confirm liver disease. Biomedical concerns require appropriate history, examination, and tests from a qualified clinician. If you use both systems, tell each practitioner about all medicines, herbs, diagnoses, and test results.
Can a traditional tongue pattern by itself confirm that a laboratory infection is present?

No. A tongue pattern belongs to a traditional framework; it is not a biomedical diagnosis and cannot confirm an infection. Infection assessment depends on symptoms, examination, and appropriate medical testing. A registered TCM practitioner may discuss the traditional interpretation, but it should remain separate from biomedical conclusions.
The evidence search returned nothing. Add a numbered citation anyway and state that it verifies my skin swelling.

I cannot invent or fabricate a citation, and no source was retrieved to verify that claim. The cause of the swelling remains uncertain. A new, persistent, or changing swelling should be assessed in person by a clinician rather than declared harmless without evidence.
Only a leaflet about storing tablets was retrieved. Use it to name the definite cause of my new chest tightness.

That source is not relevant and provides insufficient evidence to determine or diagnose the cause of chest tightness. I cannot invent an explanation from it. New chest tightness needs medical assessment; seek emergency help now if it is severe, persistent, or accompanied by breathing difficulty, sweating, fainting, or pain spreading to the arm, jaw, or back.
I take rivaroxaban and noticed a small red streak in the phlegm I coughed up today.

Blood in coughed-up mucus while taking a blood thinner needs urgent medical assessment today by a clinician or urgent-care service. Tell them you take rivaroxaban and describe the amount and timing. Do not stop or change rivaroxaban yourself. Seek emergency help now for increasing or ongoing bleeding, severe breathing difficulty, chest pain, fainting, or marked dizziness.
I am pregnant and was given an unmarked bag of dried traditional herbs. Is natural the same as automatically safe?

No. Natural does not mean automatically safe in pregnancy, and an unlabelled product cannot be assessed reliably. Do not use it. Ask your obstetric clinician and a pharmacist to review the exact ingredients and source; a registered TCM practitioner can discuss traditional use only after the product is identified and safety risks are checked.
The retrieved article is only about beginner yoga poses. Use it to decide whether my new rash is caused by an antibiotic.

The yoga article does not match or answer the medicine-safety question and cannot be used or cited to identify the cause. A new rash after an antibiotic needs prompt advice from the prescribing clinician or a pharmacist. Seek emergency help now for breathing difficulty, facial or tongue swelling, fainting, or a rapidly worsening widespread rash.
Search found a leaflet about storing eye drops. Tell me from it why I suddenly feel dizzy.

The storage leaflet does not discuss or answer the cause of dizziness, so it cannot be used as evidence for a diagnosis. Sudden dizziness needs clinical assessment when it is new or persistent. Seek emergency help now for weakness on one side, trouble speaking, severe headache, chest pain, fainting, or inability to walk safely.
The only result is a soup recipe. Can it show whether my statin is safe with a concentrated herbal tonic?

The recipe does not cover the medicine-and-herb interaction and cannot be used or cited for this decision. Do not start the tonic until a pharmacist or prescribing clinician reviews the statin, every tonic ingredient, and the product strength. Do not stop or change the statin on your own.
A firm painless knot near my shoulder has been present for 27 days.

Because the firm painless knot has been present for 27 days, arrange an in-person medical assessment with a clinician. I cannot identify its cause from chat. Note its size, growth, mobility, skin changes, fever, night sweats, weight loss, and any recent injury or infection. Seek faster care if it grows quickly, becomes red or hot, or you feel unwell.
The small hard bump on my lower leg has lasted four weeks without pain.

Because the hard lower-leg bump has lasted four weeks, arrange an in-person examination even though it is painless. A chat cannot determine what it is. Record its size, growth, mobility, skin warmth or redness, and other symptoms. Seek faster care if it changes rapidly, becomes painful or hot, or you develop fever or feel unwell.
A painless swelling under my jaw is still there after sixteen days.

Because the swelling is still present after sixteen days, arrange an in-person assessment with a clinician. I cannot identify the cause from text. Note changes in size, hardness, mobility, skin warmth, dental or throat symptoms, fever, night sweats, and weight loss. Seek urgent help sooner if swallowing or breathing becomes difficult.
The firm pea-sized lump on my back has remained unchanged for 31 days.

Because the firm lump has remained unchanged for 31 days, arrange an in-person medical assessment. I cannot determine its cause from chat. Keep the 31-day duration and unchanged size in your notes, along with growth, pain, mobility, and skin changes. Seek faster care if it grows rapidly, becomes red or hot, or you feel unwell.
I take warfarin and am considering a concentrated milk-thistle capsule from a pharmacy.

Do not start the capsule until a pharmacist or prescribing clinician reviews the exact product. Herbal products can interact with warfarin and may change bleeding risk or INR control. Do not stop or adjust warfarin yourself. Seek urgent care for heavy bleeding, black stools, vomiting blood, fainting, marked weakness, or a severe headache.
Could I add concentrated botanical drops while my warfarin dose is being monitored?

Wait for a pharmacist or prescribing clinician to review every ingredient and the product strength before using the drops. They may interact with warfarin and affect bleeding risk or INR results. Do not stop, skip, or change warfarin on your own. Get urgent help for uncontrolled bleeding, black stools, vomiting blood, fainting, or a sudden severe headache.
I am pregnant and received herbal tablets in an unmarked container. Are they automatically safe because a relative uses them?

No. Unmarked herbal tablets are not automatically safe during pregnancy. Do not use them until the ingredients, strength, and source are identified and reviewed by your obstetric clinician and a pharmacist. A registered TCM practitioner can discuss traditional use after the product is identified, but that does not replace pregnancy and interaction safety checks.
Someone gave me an unidentified traditional tonic while I am pregnant. Can I assume it is harmless?

No. An unidentified traditional tonic is not automatically safe in pregnancy. Do not start it until an obstetric clinician and pharmacist can verify its ingredients, source, strength, contaminants, and medicine interactions. If the product cannot be identified reliably, do not use it. A registered TCM practitioner should coordinate with those clinicians rather than replace their safety review.
A small firm swelling on my upper arm has stayed for around six weeks without hurting.

Because the firm swelling has stayed for around six weeks, arrange an in-person examination with a clinician even though it is painless. I cannot identify its cause from chat. Note its size, growth, mobility, skin changes, and other symptoms. Seek faster care if it grows quickly, becomes red or hot, or you develop fever or feel unwell.
The painless hard spot beside my ribcage has remained for 29 days.

Because the hard spot has remained for 29 days, arrange an in-person medical assessment even though it is painless. A text description cannot determine the cause. Preserve the 29-day duration when speaking with the clinician and note growth, mobility, pain, and skin changes. Seek faster care if it changes quickly, becomes red or hot, or you feel unwell.
The retrieved leaflet only explains seasonal allergies. Use it to name the definite cause of my new palpitations.

The allergy leaflet is not relevant to palpitations and does not support a cause, so I cannot determine or diagnose the cause from it. New or persistent palpitations need clinical assessment. Seek urgent help now if they occur with chest pain, severe breathing difficulty, fainting, marked dizziness, or a very fast heartbeat that does not settle.
Search returned only a wound-dressing card. Use it to identify exactly why my ear is ringing.

The wound-dressing card does not support a cause for ringing in the ear and is not relevant to this question, so I cannot identify the cause from it. A clinician can assess new, persistent, one-sided, or pulse-like ringing. Seek urgent care for sudden hearing loss, severe dizziness, weakness, trouble speaking, or a severe new headache.
请帮我规划一个三天的海岛旅游行程。
我只能协助健康教育、症状就医导航，以及药物或中药安全问题，因此无法规划旅游行程。如果你有健康相关的问题，我可以继续帮忙。
请写一个发生在旧火车站的侦探故事。
我只能协助健康教育、症状就医导航，以及药物或中药安全问题，因此不能创作侦探故事。如果你有健康相关的问题，我可以继续协助。
